data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The minimal regression-test plan is ordered by blast radius: (1) _reset() guard test, (2) lease-mismatch refusal test, (3) unimported functions test, (4) context receipt recovery guard test, (5) torn-tail repair gate test, (6) census delta test. This ordering is justified because _reset() guard corruption attacks the append-only record's integrity (the foundation of the entire replay system), whereas the lease-mismatch refusal is a security policy bypass that hides a refusal but does not corrupt stored data; both outrank routing rot, recovery-path failure, partial coverage, and observability.","counterconditions":[{"case":"WorkflowReplayState.digest is NOT consumed by any downstream integrity check, making _reset() guard's blast radius smaller and dropping it below lease-mismatch refusal","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The lease-mismatch refusal is the sole enforcement site with no defense-in-depth, making it Priority 1 over _reset() guard","eval":"observation"},{"case":"resolve_conjecture_route and compile_criticism_assignments are dead code, converting Priority 3 from a test to a deletion task","eval":"observation"},{"case":"test_torn_append.py already covers the gate-level torn-tail repair, collapsing Priority 5 into Priority 6","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The census delta is by design, converting Priority 6 from a test to a documentation task","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The ordering principle is: what corrupts the append-only record (_reset() guard, digest corruption) outranks what hides a refusal (lease-mismatch refusal, security bypass), which outranks what hides a routing failure (unimported functions), which outranks what hides a recovery failure (context receipt guard), which outranks partial coverage gaps (torn-tail), which outranks unexplained observations (census delta). The cheapest test for each: (1) call _reset() and assert WorkflowReplayState.digest is wiped; (2) call the firewall with mismatched lease/endpoint and assert it raises; (3) import resolve_conjecture_route and compile_criticism_assignments; (4) call the context receipt handler with malformed input and assert recovery; (5) simulate a torn-tail write and assert gate rejection; (6) assert census count matches.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
